$schema_note: Machine-specific paths live here and nowhere else. Code must read this file, never hardcode these values. Derived paths (daemon, firmware, expressions) are computed relative to this file's own location, so moving the project only requires editing python_exe if Python is also reinstalled.

hookshim.$note: Which compiled shim the settings.json hook command points at. 'exe' is the zero-dependency self-contained build; 'script' plus python_exe is the debug fallback that needs no rebuild.

arduino.$note: Only used by tooling that shells out to the IDE's own binaries. The sketch itself lives at firmware/claude_hud.
